deliberation: The final candidate materially improves the terrain mapped in rounds one and two. Its predecessor schedule is now content-addressed at an immutable parent commit, every duration label parses to its recorded seconds, the stated phase and milestone clock is an exact 0.1 transform, T0 is described non-retrospectively, ADM-B and ADM-03 occupy distinct positions inside the terminal reserve, stale human and 90-day terminology is removed, and the canonical validator and seven tests pass at exact head 4abe7653e74a3a1fd16e8b9e72e5c61646718241. The remaining defects are in the topology actually enforced, not in the intent. The dependency validator checks only that each listed execution gate directly names OPS-A. It accepts a CMDG-A/CMDG-B cycle, an unknown GHOST predecessor, a duplicate execution gate, and removal of CMDG-A even though CMDG-A is a Phase 1 exit. It assigns no deadlines to graph nodes and does not bind phase-exit membership to the plan, so it cannot reject a predecessor later than its dependent or prove the advertised phase graph. Source correspondence is also one-way: removing milestone D from the transform remains valid, so the validator does not prove one-to-one coverage of the frozen schedule. The activation schema is closed syntactically but does not identify the protected repository, branch, protected-main readback head, candidate-to-merge ancestry result, or merge timestamp, and it permits t0_utc to differ from readback_completed_at_utc. Consequently it cannot establish the non-retrospective activation event or distinguish reviewed candidate, merge commit, and later protected head. Finally, OPS-00 still describes the five-repository baseline only in prose, without the repository/branch/SHA/observed-at/readback-evidence and active-contract digest tuples required to reconstruct a moving cross-repository cut. The ordered terminal offsets are coherent, but no cutoff-snapshot or occurrence-ledger contract makes the runtime observation-cutoff to ADM-B to ADM-03 to terminal-packet chain fail closed. These defects leave the exact plan understandable but not yet the executable dependency and identity map required by the prior Cartographer conditions. Because repair changes governed plan, manifest, schema, validator, or test bytes, conditional approval cannot cure them after review.
